latest.title: Cross-Document Filtering in OpenSearch: A Two-Phase Pattern with Roaring Bitmaps
latest.description: When your filters live on sibling documents that share a parent — a case and its notes, an order and its line items — a single bool query can't express the constraint. This article walks through a two-phase pattern that intersects parent IDs in memory and uses OpenSearch 2.17+ native roaring bitmap filters to scale the final search past max_result_window.

latest.title: How I Built a Team of AI Agents I Can Finally Trust (and the Conformance System That Made It Possible)
latest.description: My agents kept passing code that confidently missed the point. The fix was never a better model or more agents. It was four structural artifacts that hold every agent accountable to what was actually approved, and a conformance system that finally made multi-agent output trustworthy.

trending.description: ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is an AI-powered claim verification platform built on AWS that verifies scientific claims against 1.2M+ peer-reviewed papers across 8 domains — and automatically fetches and permanently stores new papers from arXiv, PubMed, etc. when gaps are found, making the knowledge base self-growing with every query.
